
## INSTALL LIBRARIES
```{r}
install.packages("AmesHousing")
install.packages("dplyr")
install.packages("kableExtra")
install.packages("car")

library(AmesHousing)
library(kableExtra)
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(car)

ames_raw <- AmesHousing::ames_raw 
ames     <- make_ames()             

```
```{r}
# DATA DESCRIPTION PART

nrow(ames)
summary(ames$Sale_Price)
summary(ames$Central_Air)
summary(ames$Bldg_Type)
summary(ames$Year_Built)
summary(ames$Garage_Cars)
summary(ames$Neighborhood)
summary(ames$Gr_Liv_Area)
summary(ames$Year_Remod_Add)
summary(ames$Lot_Area)
summary(ames$Overall_Qual)
plot(ames$Gr_Liv_Area, ames$Overall_Qual)
round(100 * prop.table(table(ames$Overall_Qual)), 1)
round(100 * prop.table(table(ames$Bldg_Type)), 1)
round(100 * prop.table(table(ames$Central_Air)), 1)
round(100 * prop.table(table(ames$Neighborhood)), 1)
ggplot(ames, aes(x = Gr_Liv_Area, y = Sale_Price, color = Overall_Qual)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(
    title = "Relation Between Living Area and Sale Price by Overall Quality",
    x = "Gr_Liv_Area",
    y = "Sale_Price",
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```
## 1) Fit a preliminary model using at least 9 predictors from your dataset
```{r, fig.height=3.5, fig.width=3.5}
# Fit a preliminary model using at least 9 predictors from your dataset
ames$Overall_Qual <- relevel(ames$Overall_Qual, ref = "Average")
og_model <- lm(Sale_Price ~ Year_Built + Gr_Liv_Area + Year_Remod_Add + 
                 Garage_Cars + Lot_Area + Overall_Qual + Neighborhood + 
                 Bldg_Type + Central_Air + Overall_Qual*Gr_Liv_Area, data = ames)
# summary
summary(og_model)

```
## 2) Display your preliminary model in a table or a figure, ensuring that standard errors and/or confidence intervals are included
```{r, fig.height=3.5, fig.width=3.5}
# A) FULL VERSION

coefficients <- summary(og_model)$coefficients      
CI    <- confint(og_model)  

table <- data.frame(
  Estimate = round(coefficients[, "Estimate"], 3),
  SE       = round(coefficients[, "Std. Error"], 3),
  Lower95  = round(CI[, 1], 3),
  Upper95  = round(CI[, 2], 3),
  p_value  = round(coefficients[, "Pr(>|t|)"], 3)
)

table$p_value <- ifelse(table$p_value == 0.000,
                         "<0.001",
                         table$p_value)

knitr::kable(table, 
             format = "html", 
             caption = "Coefficients, with their relative Standard Errors and Confidence Intervals"
             )

# B) COMPACT VERSION FOR THE REPORT

kept_coefs <- c("Year_Built", "Gr_Liv_Area", "Garage_Cars", "Year_Remod_Add", 
                "Lot_Area", "Central_AirY", "Gr_Liv_Area:Overall_QualExcellent", 
                "Overall_QualExcellent", "Bldg_TypeDuplex", "NeighborhoodCollege_Creek")

table_compact <- data.frame(
  Estimate = round(coefficients[kept_coefs, "Estimate"], 3),
  SE       = round(coefficients[kept_coefs, "Std. Error"], 3),
  Lower_95_CI  = round(CI[kept_coefs, 1], 3),
  Upper_95_CI  = round(CI[kept_coefs, 2], 3),
  p_value  = round(coefficients[kept_coefs, "Pr(>|t|)"], 3)
) %>%
  rename("Std. Err" = SE,
         "Lower 95% CI" = Lower_95_CI, 
         "Upper 95% CI" = Upper_95_CI, 
        )

table_compact$p_value <- ifelse(table_compact$p_value == 0.000,
                         "<0.001",
                         table_compact$p_value)

rownames(table_compact) <- c("Year built",
                             "Living area slope (Average quality baseline)",
                             "Garage capacity (cars)",
                             "Year remodelled", "Lot area (sq ft)", "Air Conditioning=yes", 
                             "Living area × Excellent quality", 
                             "Quality=excellent (vs Average)", 
                             "Building type=duplex (vs single-family)", 
                             "Neighbourhood=College Creek (vs North Ames)")

knitr::kable(table_compact, 
             format = "html", 
             caption = "Selected coefficients, with their relative Standard Errors, Confidence Intervals, and p values",
             align = "r"
             ) %>%
              kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center") 

# C) Interaction Term 
interaction_terms <- c("Gr_Liv_Area","Gr_Liv_Area:Overall_QualVery_Poor", "Gr_Liv_Area:Overall_QualPoor", "Gr_Liv_Area:Overall_QualFair", 
                       "Gr_Liv_Area:Overall_QualBelow_Average", 
                       "Gr_Liv_Area:Overall_QualAbove_Average", "Gr_Liv_Area:Overall_QualGood", 
                       "Gr_Liv_Area:Overall_QualVery_Good", "Gr_Liv_Area:Overall_QualExcellent",                  
                       "Gr_Liv_Area:Overall_QualVery_Excellent")

table_interaction <- data.frame(
  Estimate = round(coefficients[interaction_terms, "Estimate"], 3),
  SE       = round(coefficients[interaction_terms, "Std. Error"], 3),
  Lower_95_CI  = round(CI[interaction_terms, 1], 3),
  Upper_95_CI  = round(CI[interaction_terms, 2], 3),
  p_value  = round(coefficients[interaction_terms, "Pr(>|t|)"], 3)
) %>%
  rename("Std. Err" = SE,
         "Lower 95% CI" = Lower_95_CI, 
         "Upper 95% CI" = Upper_95_CI, 
        )

table_interaction$p_value <- ifelse(table_interaction$p_value == 0.000,
                         "<0.001",
                         table_interaction$p_value)

knitr::kable(table_interaction, 
             format = "html", 
             caption = "Baseline and Interaction terms, with their relative Standard Errors, Confidence Intervals, and p values",
             align = "r"
             ) %>%
              kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")
```

## 3.1) The required plots (residuals vs fitted, rediuals vs each predictor, normal q-q plot)
```{r, fig.height=3.5, fig.width=3.5}
png("res_norm_plots.png", width = 3000, height = 3000, res = 200)
par(mfrow = c(4, 3))        

# RESIDUAL VS. FITTED
y_value <- resid(og_model)
x_value <- fitted(og_model)
plot(x = x_value, y = y_value, main="Residual vs Fitted", xlab="Fitted",
     ylab="Residuals")
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

# RESIDUAL VS. EACH PREDICTOR
plot(x = ames$Year_Built, y = resid(og_model),
     main = "Residuals vs Year Built",
     xlab = "Year_Built", ylab = "Residuals")
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

plot(x = ames$Gr_Liv_Area, y = resid(og_model),
     main = "Residuals vs Above Ground Living Area",
     xlab = "Gr_Liv_Area", ylab = "Residuals")
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

plot(x = ames$Year_Remod_Add, y = resid(og_model),
     main = "Residuals vs Remodel Date",
     xlab = "Year_Remod_Add", ylab = "Residuals")
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

plot(x = ames$Garage_Cars, y = resid(og_model),
     main = "Residuals vs Car capacity in Garage",
     xlab = "Garage_Cars", ylab = "Residuals")
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

plot(x = ames$Lot_Area, y = resid(og_model),
     main = "Residuals vs Lot Area",
     xlab = "Lot_Area", ylab = "Residuals")
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

plot(x = ames$Overall_Qual, y = resid(og_model),
     main = "Residuals vs Rating of Material",
     xlab = "Overall_Qual", ylab = "Residuals")
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

plot(x = ames$Neighborhood, y = resid(og_model),
     main = "Residuals vs Neighborhood",
     xlab = "Neighborhood", ylab = "Residuals")
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

plot(x = ames$Bldg_Type, y = resid(og_model),
     main = "Residuals vs Building Type",
     xlab = "Bldg_Type", ylab = "Residuals")
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

plot(x = ames$Central_Air, y = resid(og_model),
     main = "Residuals vs Central Air Conditioning",
     xlab = "Central_Air", ylab = "Residuals")
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

# NORMAL Q-Q PLOT
qqnorm(resid(og_model))
qqline(resid(og_model))

dev.off() 
```

```{r}

     main = "Response vs Fitted", xlab = "Fitted", ylab = "Sale_Price")
abline(0, 1, lty = 2)                                   
lines(lowess(fitted(og_model), ames$Sale_Price), col = "red")   

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
dev.off()
```

## 4) WHAT WILL BE IN THE REPORT
```{r}
png("REPORT.png", width = 3000, height = 1200, res = 200)
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))        

# RESIDUAL VS. FITTED
y_value <- resid(og_model)
x_value <- fitted(og_model)
plot(x = x_value, y = y_value, main="Residual vs Fitted", xlab="Fitted",
     ylab="Residuals")
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

# NORMAL Q-Q PLOT
qqnorm(resid(og_model))
qqline(resid(og_model))

# COND MEAN RESPONSE
plot(x = x_value, y = ames$Sale_Price,
     main = "Response vs Fitted", xlab = "Fitted", ylab = "Sale_Price")
abline(0, 1, lty = 2)                                   
lines(lowess(fitted(og_model), ames$Sale_Price), col = "red")   

dev.off()
```

```{r}
#Sale price vs Above ground living area categorized per each Overall_Qual variable
png("scatterplot.png", width = 1500, height = 1200, res = 200)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))    
cols <- c("#3B0F70", "#4A2A8C", "#3F4A9E", "#31679F", "#2A829A",
          "#27A08A", "#4DB871", "#8CCB52", "#CDD83A", "#F2C230")


ggplot(ames, aes(x = Gr_Liv_Area, y = Sale_Price, colour = Overall_Qual)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15, size = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cols) +
  labs(x = "Above-ground living area (sq ft)",
       y = "Sale price",
       colour = "Overall quality")
dev.off()

# Check how many houses classify as very excellent
count_very_excellent <- sum(ames$Overall_Qual == "Very_Excellent")
count_very_excellent
count_average <- sum(ames$Overall_Qual == "Average")
count_average

# Anova test to see if the interaction term improves the model
no_int_model <- lm(Sale_Price ~ Year_Built + Gr_Liv_Area + Year_Remod_Add + 
                 Garage_Cars + Lot_Area + Overall_Qual + Neighborhood + 
                 Bldg_Type + Central_Air, data = ames)
anova(no_int_model, og_model)
 

```

```{r}
# BoxCox to find which exponent for the response
bc <- boxCox(og_model)   
bc$x[which.max(bc$y)]   
```
